name: OpenConfig Reference
what_it_is: A reference repository containing specifications, tooling, and reference implementations for OpenConfig-based network management, primarily focused on gNMI (gRPC Network Management Interface) and YANG data models. It provides protobuf definitions and documentation rather than a runnable simulation environment.
components: rpc/ — gNMI RPC definitions and protobuf specifications
ietf/ — IETF-related OpenConfig content and mappings
measurement: gNMI Subscribe RPC for streaming telemetry (defined in spec)
gNMI Get RPC for state/config retrieval (defined in spec)
configuration: gNMI Set RPC for device configuration (defined in spec)
OpenConfig YANG model paths for configuration targeting
modes: Reference/specification mode — read protobuf and documentation only
Tooling mode — run included Python scripts for OpenConfig-related tasks
constraints: No runnable network simulation or emulated devices included — this is a spec/reference repo, not a sandbox
No Docker or container infrastructure; cannot be spun up as a self-contained environment
No published releases or versioned packages; consumers must pin to a git commit
Requires an external gNMI-capable target (real device or separate emulator) to exercise the RPC definitions
notable_absences: No Docker Compose or container definitions
No emulated network devices or virtual targets
No fault injection or chaos testing capabilities
No test runner or CI configuration visible in the repository root
No gNMI server implementation (only client-side specs and tooling)
